title: Return an owned reading
prompt: Return a std::unique_ptr<int> that owns a newly created int with the requested value. Each call must create its own object. Do not return an address of a local variable.

tests.label: Stores requested value
tests.hint: Return a non-null owner initialized with the argument.

tests.label: Preserves negative values
tests.hint: The pointed-to value should equal the input.

tests.label: Separate objects
tests.hint: Each call needs a new owned object.

hints: std::make_unique creates an object and returns its owner.
The owner releases the object when the owner is destroyed.
explanation: make_unique<int>(value) constructs an int in owned dynamic storage. Returning its unique_ptr transfers that responsibility safely to the caller.
